releaseStatus.reason: Ready (Gate 2 main run all succeeded; work/20260926-1100-Gate2-TerminalState.md). All four roles are approved: C6 classification MobileNetV3 Large IMAGENET1K_V2 and C6 detection SSDLite320 MobileNetV3 Large COCO_V1 under an owner risk acceptance for the rights layer (FR-LIC-016) with measured windows-x64 cpu and directml parity (per the owner ruling D1 of 2026-09-23, the POC-03 real-time criteria are verified on the product Model Version inference path in the INF phase); C7 classification google/siglip-base-patch16-224 (approved 2026-09-25; gold-set top-1 accuracy without a threshold 0.35, close to chance for 3 labels); and C7 detection google/owlvit-base-patch32 (approved 2026-09-26; assist suggestions limited to research purposes, FR-LIC-003; gold-set F1 0.2478). Per the owner ruling G2D-01, the C7 cpu inference latency is recorded but not used as an adoption criterion. The assist quality comparison (NFR-ANN-006, POC-16 quality and time) was removed from the Version 1 tasks and treated as complete without being run (owner ruling of 2026-09-26, docs/model-governance/evidence/2026-09-26-owner-rulings.md); releaseStatus.assistQuality is therefore empty and the assist benefit is unverified. The product version is 0.1.12 (owner ruling G2D-08). The PKG-01 release verifier (scripts/models/verify.py) checks the approved source payloads, evidence and approval records before packaging; a packaged payload is checked with the same script against its payload root (ADR-0004).

inferenceConfig.scoreMeaning: Per-label independent sigmoid(exp(logit_scale) * cos + logit_bias). It is not a probability of correctness, it is not calibrated, and the scores do not sum to 1 across labels.
inferenceConfig.thresholdPolicy: G2Q-03 policy A: among thresholds with coverage of at least 0.5 on the classification gold set, the one with the highest agreement of the suggested items; the recorded value is the midpoint between the selected score and the next lower candidate. Label prompt: 'This is a photo of {label}.' with underscores in the label name replaced by spaces. Evidence: spikes/models/siglip-assist-result.md section 8.

inferenceConfig.scoreMeaning: Per-patch sigmoid of the maximum logit in the text-query direction. It is not a probability of correctness and it is not calibrated.
inferenceConfig.thresholdPolicy: G2Q-03 policy A: among thresholds with coverage of at least 0.5 on the detection gold set, the one with the highest F1 (IoU of at least 0.5, one-to-one); the recorded value is the midpoint between the selected score and the next lower candidate. Text query: 'a photo of a {label}' with underscores in the class name replaced by spaces. Boundary: score >= threshold. Evidence: spikes/models/owlvit-assist-result.md section 7.2.
